content.title: Is the Path Everyone Takes Really the Right One?
content.subtitle: If the crowd leads you away from truth, where will your journey end?
content.body:
Have you ever, on a lonely night, placed your hand over the solitary beat of your heart? That heartbeat is alone. Completely alone. Yet when daylight comes, how strangely we surrender ourselves to blindness! Our hearts seek an easy reassurance—“Everyone is doing it. What’s wrong if I do it too?” We judge truth by numbers, by the crowd. Yet this very crowd can become a trap, pulling us toward Hell. Allah Almighty warned His beloved Messenger ﷺ: “And if you obey most of those upon the earth, they will mislead you from the way of Allah. They follow nothing but assumption, and they do nothing but guess.” (Surah Al-An‘am: 116)

The Endless Darkness of Ingratitude

We become overwhelmed by the luxurious lives and so-called modernity of others. The current around us convinces us that worldly indulgence is the purpose of life. Yet are we grateful to the One who has given us so much? Not at all. Allah says: “And few of My servants are grateful.” (Surah Saba: 13)

When billions remain dissatisfied despite receiving the Creator’s blessings, have you become one of those rare, peaceful and surrendered “few”? Or have you too been caught in the procession of ingratitude, captivated by numbers?

The Terrifying Scale: 999 Out of Every 1,000

This hadith is enough to send a chill through the body. On the terrifying Day of Judgment, Allah will call upon Adam (A.S.) and say, “O Adam! Bring out the people of Hell.” Adam (A.S.) will ask, “O my Lord, how many?” Allah will say, “From every thousand, nine hundred and ninety-nine (999)!” (Sahih al-Bukhari: 3348, 6530; Sahih Muslim: 222)

When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ told the Companions this, their faces turned pale with fear. They asked, “O Messenger of Allah! Who among us will be that one?”

In a crowd of one thousand, 999 are swept toward Hell, while only one remains firm upon the truth and enters Paradise. So ask yourself—when you say “everyone is doing it,” are you not writing your name among those 999?

The Wanderer Who Stands Against the Current

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ described the condition of his Ummah: “Islam began as something strange, and it will return to being strange as it began. So glad tidings to the strangers.” (Sahih Muslim: 145)

In another narration, he said: “They are a small number of righteous people among a large number of evil people. Those who disobey them are more numerous than those who obey them.” (Musnad Ahmad: 6650)

When you reject unlawful bribes, guard your eyes from adultery and obscenity, and seek halal sustenance while others pursue wealth through dishonest means—society may mock you. But that very mockery may become your dowry for Paradise.

So, Which Path Will You Choose?

Think about it. In the grave where you will be placed, society will not be there. There will be no trends, no going viral, no comparison with that “someone’s son” from the family. Beneath three and a half cubits of earth, you will be completely alone.

On that terrifying Day, Allah will not ask you, “What did you do? And what did everyone else do?” Rather, your Lord may ask, “Despite My clear guidance, why did you blindly follow the crowd? Did I not warn you?” What will your answer be then?

So, my brother! Do not lose yourself in the fleeting applause of this world or in the procession of the masses. Have the courage to walk alone. Hold firmly to the truth. Being few in number is not defeat; remaining right in the sight of Allah is eternal freedom.
